headline: Bitcoin is hovering around $80,000 ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision, Ripple's new US trust bank and BNY custody deal are the day's big crypto business news, and Robinhood's results land overnight Bangkok time.

market.asOf: Read from the CoinMarketCap homepage around 19:58 UTC Tue 27 Oct (02:58 Wed Bangkok). The 24h change is left out because its direction could not be confirmed on the page. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 44, Neutral, on the CMC Crypto Fear & Greed Index (CoinMarketCap), read around 19:58 UTC 27 Oct.

stories.title: Ripple gets its US trust bank, and BNY adds XRP and RLUSD custody
stories.summary: The OCC, the US regulator for national banks, gave Ripple final approval to launch Ripple National Trust Bank, which will hold the reserves behind its RLUSD stablecoin. On Tuesday BNY added XRP and RLUSD to its custody platform for institutions. XRP's price barely reacted, and the charter does not require anyone to buy XRP.
points: Final approval follows conditional approval on 12 Dec 2025; the bank will hold segregated RLUSD reserves, and national trust charters do not allow deposit-taking or lending, per The Block.
Circle got final OCC approval for its own trust bank in July 2026, and Sen. Warren has criticized these approvals, per The Block.
BNY added XRP and RLUSD to its institutional custody platform, and its clients are to be able to mint and redeem RLUSD directly, per The Block.
RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, with Robinhood app availability expected later this year, per The Block.
XRP was trading near $1.25; Marex said the charter itself creates no requirement to buy XRP, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Bitcoin hovers around $80,000 as the Fed meets; the decision is Wednesday
stories.summary: Bitcoin spent Tuesday either side of $80,000 on day one of the Fed's two-day meeting. Markets expect rates to stay where they are on Wednesday afternoon US time. A large batch of bitcoin options expires on Friday.
points: Futures traders priced a 90.6% chance the Fed holds its range at 3.75-4.00%, up from 84.5% a week earlier, per CME FedWatch data reported by Fox Business.
CoinDesk's Daybook called $80,000 the key support zone, and options pricing for Friday's expiry implied a move of about 3% either way.
Puts, which pay off if the price falls, made up 91% of the roughly $32M traded at the $80,000 bitcoin options strike over the past week, per Derive data reported by The Block.
US spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $110.3M on Monday 26 Oct, all into BlackRock's IBIT, after a $137.9M outflow on 23 Oct, per TFTC.
Estimates for Friday's Deribit bitcoin options expiry range from about $11B to $12B, with 'max pain' estimates between $76,000 and $79,000, per FinanceFeeds. Max pain is not a price target.

stories.title: Crypto earnings week: Robinhood after today's close, Coinbase and Strategy on Thursday
stories.summary: Robinhood reports after the US close on Tuesday, with its call at 04:00 Wednesday Bangkok time. Galaxy already reported a $323M quarterly profit, and Coinbase and Strategy report on Thursday. These results show how active everyday crypto traders were from July to September.
points: Robinhood reports after market close on 27 Oct, with a call at 2:00pm PT / 5:00pm ET (04:00 Wed Bangkok), per Robinhood.
Analysts expect Robinhood earnings of $0.558 a share on $1.44B of revenue, per MarketBeat.
Galaxy reported Q3 net income of $323M, against an $85M loss in Q2, and authorized a new $200M share buyback, per The Block.
Coinbase reports after market close on Thursday 29 Oct, with a Q&A at 2:00pm PT (5:00pm ET, 04:00 Fri Bangkok), per Coinbase's announcement.

briefs.title: CFTC sues Utah over prediction markets
briefs.summary: The CFTC sued Utah and its attorney general on 27 Oct over Kalshi, the tenth state it has sued in the fight over who regulates prediction markets, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto.com brings perpetual futures to US traders
briefs.summary: Crypto.com and OG.com began rolling out perpetual futures with up to 5x leverage to eligible US traders on 27 Oct, on OG.com's CFTC-regulated exchange, per The Block. Leverage magnifies losses as well as gains.

briefs.title: Ark sells some of its bitcoin ETF and buys Circle
briefs.summary: Ark sold $15.9M of its ARKB bitcoin ETF and bought $5.2M of Circle shares after CRCL fell 7.1% on Monday, per The Block.

briefs.title: Canada drafts stablecoin rules that ban paying interest
briefs.summary: Canada released draft stablecoin rules that ban paying interest, require 1:1 reserves and redemption within 3 business days; consultation runs to 23 Dec, per KuCoin's daily report.
